summary: Eyewitness reliability in mob violence case; solitary witness identification; 50-100 persons in mob; two-year lapse; no test identification parade; conviction based solely on PW-2 testimony; legal standard: single eyewitness admissible only if wholly reliable; chain-snatching allegation; impugned conviction reversed due to unreliable identification under crowded conditions; legal principles from Vadivelu Thevar case applied.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.396 read with s.149
Indian Penal Code s.395 read with s.149
Indian Penal Code s.307 read with s.149
Indian Penal Code s.435 read with s.149
Indian Penal Code s.201 read with s.149
final_judgment: Appellant acquitted; impugned conviction set aside; benefit of acquittal not extended to other co-accused.
